definitions.explanation: An estimate that is not exact; used when giving approximate numbers or amounts.
In general terms; for the most part.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}で{着|つ}きます。
examples.english: It takes approximately 30 minutes to arrive.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}の{見積|みつも}もりを{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please give me a rough estimate.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}{百人|ひゃくにん}が{集|あつ}まった。
{費用|ひよう}は{大凡|おおよそ}{五万円|ごまんえん}ぐらいだと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think the cost will be roughly 50,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}は{大凡|おおよそ}{三|さん}か{月|げつ}で{終|お}わる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The construction is expected to finish in roughly three months.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}の{計画|けいかく}は{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The general plan has been decided.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}の{内容|ないよう}は{分|わ}かった。
{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて{大凡|おおよそ}の{事情|じじょう}がつかめた。
examples.english: After listening, I grasped the general situation.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}{想像|そうぞう}がつくと{思|おも}いますが、{結果|けっか}はよくありませんでした。
examples.english: As you can probably imagine, the results were not good.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}を{見|み}れば{大凡|おおよそ}の{場所|ばしょ}は{分|わ}かるだろう。
examples.english: If you look at the map, you'll probably figure out the general location.

notes:
USAGE: {大凡|おおよそ} is often written in hiragana (おおよそ) in modern usage.

POSITION: Usually appears before numbers or nouns.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{大凡|おおよそ}の{見当|けんとう} (rough idea)
・{大凡|おおよそ}の{数|かず} (approximate number)
・{大凡|おおよそ}{想像|そうぞう}がつく (can roughly imagine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{約|やく}〜 - about, approximately (more common for numbers)
・だいたい - roughly, generally (more casual)
・およそ - approximately (similar but can also mean 'at all' in negative contexts)
・ざっと - roughly, at a glance
